sources.title: BB8 - A Transformer-Based Large Language Model - GitHub
sources.snippet: BB8 is a custom GPT-style Transformer decoder language model built entirely from scratch. This project is not designed to compete with production-scale models like GPT-4, Gemini, or Llama.
